newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL APPROVES 3.7 PCT DIVIDEND FOR 1996.
newsitem.headline: MOL APPROVES 3.7 PCT DIVIDEND FOR 1996.

text.p: The shareholders of Hungarian oil and gas company MOL decided on Wednesday to pay 37 forint or 3.7 percent dividend on the 1996 earnings, up from nine forints paid from 1995 profits. 8 "When considering the yield of your shares, you should also take into account the increase of the share price over the last year," MOL chairman Laszlo Pal told the shareholders' annual meeting.
He added that one year ago the stock was sold at around 1,300 forints, compared with the current price of 3,380 forints.
The shares sold at domestic and international offerings earlier this month will also pay dividend, MOL officials said.
The state privatisation agency APV sold some 19 percent of MOL's shares through the offerings.
